items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: And Waken, Plaston. That was a solid old man, wasn't he?

ctx.x: And Waken, Plaston. That was a solid old man, wasn't he?
Yeah, well, I thought he was drinking. He was doing as high as this and drink. And drinking wine. Good wine, not that. Oh, he was drinking anything though far.
